families.decision: Organic whole grains from a named farm, with sprouted packs first.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer an added Real Organic seal.
Read the ingredient line for whole grains without sweeteners or flavourings.
Pick a named small farm or mill with the growing region on the pack.
Check for sprouted wording and an intact, sealed package.

families.decision: Organic soaked and dried nuts or seeds from a named small grower.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and soaked, sprouted or activated wording.
Read the ingredients for nuts or seeds, with optional salt or unsweetened fruit.
Pick sealed raw or dry-roasted packs when soaked-and-dried nuts are absent.
Skip added oils, sugar, syrups and flavourings in the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic single-source sweeteners from a named beekeeper or small farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and the actual sweetener named on the label.
Check the beekeeper or farm name, region and lot number.
Read the ingredient line for the named sweetener itself.
Skip flavoured syrup blends and added corn syrup.

families.decision: Organic dried beans, peas and lentils from a named small farm.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic; prefer an added Real Organic seal.
Check the farm name, growing region and crop year or lot number.
Read whole, split or sprouted on the pack to identify the form.
Skip packs with insects, webbing or damp clumps.

families.decision: Organic flour from a named small mill, with the plant and milling date disclosed.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and the grain, nut or root named on the pack.
Pick whole-grain flour when choosing a grain-based flour.
Check the milling date and choose the freshest sealed pack.
Read the ingredients for plain flour without bleaching agents or flavourings.

families.decision: Organic herbs, spices and tea with named plants and a disclosed growing origin.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and a named farm, grower group or growing region.
Read every ingredient in a blend; skip added flavours and fillers.
Pick sealed packs with visible whole leaves, seeds or bark where practical.
Check harvest or packing dates and skip damp, clumped or faded stock.

families.decision: Organic traditional fats with the source and processing named.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and the farm, dairy or olive estate on the label.
Read every fat named in the ingredients, including blends.
Pick extra virgin olive oil, virgin coconut oil or pasture-raised animal fats.
Skip hydrogenated fats and added flavours in the ingredient list.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough or sprouted baking from a named small bakery.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and a named local or small bakery.
Read every flour ingredient for whole-grain or whole-wheat wording.
Check for sprouted grains or a printed starter-fermentation process.
Skip added gluten, soy flour, isolated bran and dough conditioners.

families.decision: Organic whole-grain bread fermented with a live starter by a named small bakery.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and whole-grain flours throughout the ingredient list.
Read the pack or shelf card for live-starter fermentation.
Check for a named local bakery and its grain or mill source.
Skip added baker's yeast, sourdough flavouring and vinegar used for souring.

families.decision: Organic corn masa foods from a named small maker, with lime treatment disclosed.
buying_tips: Look for USDA Organic and the corn grower or growing region.
Read nixtamalized, lime-treated corn or corn with calcium hydroxide.
Check every ingredient, including any frying or coating oil.
Skip artificial colours, flavours and preservatives in the ingredient list.

rice_arsenic.decision: Organic California-grown white basmati from a named farm.
rice_arsenic.delta: Basmati is the variety; California-grown is the origin wording to find.

oats_steelcut_rolled_instant.decision: Plain organic sprouted oats from a named farm.
oats_steelcut_rolled_instant.delta: Steel-cut oats are chopped groats; rolled and quick oats are flattened flakes.

nuts_raw_vs_roasted.decision: Organic soaked and dehydrated nuts from a small grower, in sealed packs.
nuts_raw_vs_roasted.delta: For almonds labelled raw, check the pack for steam-pasteurization details.

honey_adulteration.decision: Organic raw, unfiltered honey from a named local beekeeper.
honey_adulteration.delta: Raw and unfiltered on the jar; crystallization is normal.

beans_dried_vs_canned.decision: Organic dried beans from a named small farm, with intact skins.
beans_dried_vs_canned.delta: Whole dried beans have unbroken skins; canned beans need only beans, water and optional salt.

flour_basics.decision: Freshly milled organic sprouted whole-grain flour from a named small mill.
flour_basics.delta: A 100% extraction label means the bran, germ and endosperm are all retained.

bulk_bins_buying.decision: Organic dried beans or lentils in clean, covered bins with clear source labels.
bulk_bins_buying.delta: Choose sealed packs for nuts, brown rice and milled whole-grain flour.

whole_spices.decision: Organic whole spices from a named small grower, in sealed packs.
whole_spices.delta: Peppercorns, cumin seeds and cinnamon sticks instead of powders.

rancidity_check.decision: Organic extra virgin olive oil in a sealed dark bottle or tin, with a harvest date.
rancidity_check.delta: Skip bottles in direct sun or beside heat; avoid dusty stock.

olive_oil_grades.decision: Organic extra virgin olive oil from a named estate, with a recent harvest date.
olive_oil_grades.delta: Harvest month and year on the bottle; choose the newest harvest shown.

nut_butter_ingredients.decision: Organic soaked or sprouted nut butter, just nuts and optional salt.
nut_butter_ingredients.delta: An oil layer is normal in unstabilized nut butter.

grains_beyond_rice.decision: Organic sprouted whole grains from a named small farm.
grains_beyond_rice.delta: For barley, choose hulled or hulless on the label; pearled barley has bran removed.

bottled_water_buying.decision: Plain natural mineral or spring water from a named source, in glass.
bottled_water_buying.delta: Read the source name and the bottler's latest dated water-quality report.

sandwich_bread.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough or sprouted sandwich bread from a small bakery.
sandwich_bread.delta: For a sliced loaf, read keep-frozen or freeze-upon-arrival instructions on the bag.

sourdough.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough, live-starter fermented, from a named small bakery.
sourdough.delta: Flour, water and salt can include the starter; read a stated fermentation time.

bagels.decision: Organic whole-grain sourdough or sprouted bagels from a named small bakery.
bagels.delta: Boiled then baked on the pack.

tortillas.decision: Organic fresh-nixtamal corn tortillas, corn, water and lime with optional salt.
tortillas.delta: Fresh wet masa first, masa harina next; lime here means calcium hydroxide.

breakfast_cereal.decision: Plain organic sprouted whole-grain hot cereal in a sealed pack.
breakfast_cereal.delta: Choose flakes or groats for hot cereal; boxed granola should say soaked.

groups.title: Whole-grain sandwich loaves and bagels
groups.why_same: Both use the organic seal, whole-grain flour list, sprouting or starter fermentation and a named small bakery.

groups.title: Plain sprouted oats and other cooking grains
groups.why_same: Both use organic certification, a named grower, sprouted whole-grain wording and a plain sealed pack.

groups.title: Extra virgin olive oil and shelf freshness
groups.why_same: Both use extra virgin wording, organic certification, a named estate, a harvest date and protective packaging.
